definitions.explanation: A digital address, most commonly an email address or URL. In everyday Japanese, アドレス alone usually means email address.

examples.japanese: メールアドレスを{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me your email address.

examples.japanese: アドレスを{間違|まちが}えて{別|べつ}の{人|ひと}に{送|おく}ってしまった。
examples.english: I made a mistake with the address and sent it to the wrong person.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいアドレスに{変更|へんこう}したので、{連絡先|れんらくさき}を{更新|こうしん}してください。
examples.english: I've changed to a new address, so please update your contacts.

notes:
From English "address." In Japanese, アドレス almost exclusively refers to digital addresses (email, web). For physical postal addresses, {住所|じゅうしょ} is used instead. Sometimes shortened to アド in very casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メールアドレス: email address
- アドレスを{変更|へんこう}する: to change one's address
- アドレス{帳|ちょう}: address book (contacts)
- アドレスバー: address bar (in a web browser)
- IPアドレス: IP address

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {住所|じゅうしょ}: address (physical) — for postal/residential addresses
- URL: URL — specifically for web addresses, more technical
- {連絡先|れんらくさき}: contact information — broader, includes phone, email, etc.
